text: What are Neoclouds CoreWeave Nebius: cloud firms that rent AI computing power. Neoclouds are cloud computing companies built mainly to rent out graphics processing units (GPUs), the chips that train and run artificial intelligence software. CoreWeave and Nebius are two named examples, and both rallied on the Tuesday AMD reported its third-quarter results, remaining higher after the report.. AMD reported third-quarter revenue up 45% and said its data center business is growing fast, and the company's shares and neocloud shares like CoreWeave and Nebius rose together on the same day.. Neoclouds differ from hyperscalers, the very large cloud providers that also sell AI computing time. AMD's data center sales made up 64% of its overall revenue in the quarter, up from 47% a year earlier. Its chief executive, Lisa Su, said she expects server revenue to double in 2027, which points to continued demand for the computing hardware that neoclouds buy and rent out.

What is Meta Muse AI app: an agent launched Sept. 8, 2026. Meta Muse is an AI agent made by Meta Platforms and announced on September 8, 2026. Unlike a chatbot that answers one question at a time, it is built to handle tasks that run over a long period for the user. It is offered in the United States on iPhone, Android and the web.. AMD reported third-quarter results on Tuesday with data center revenue nearly doubling, and CEO Lisa Su credited growth in agentic AI apps, naming Meta's Muse as an example. Her comments on the earnings call tie the product to that demand.. Meta presents Muse as a personal agent, meaning software that works on a goal for the user across many steps instead of giving one reply per request. Background on its launch describes that design as its main difference from a standard chatbot. Chip maker AMD ties its own results to Muse. In its earnings call, CEO Lisa Su said Muse was one of the best examples of fast adoption, with more than 10 million people activating it within 45 days. Agent software of this kind runs for long periods, and AMD says its server processors are well suited to that workload. Why it matters now: AMD reported third-quarter revenue up 45% and data center sales nearly doubling from a year earlier, and Su expects server revenue to double in 2027. Her comments link that growth to demand from agent apps such as Muse. Meta also said its Helios racks, built with AMD technology, are up and running.
